explication: LiveContainer is an iOS app launcher that stores apps and their data inside the host app, then launches selected guest apps without installing each as a separate system app. The main workflow is app selection and management in the SwiftUI interface, followed by guest launch; signing is used when the documented JIT-based codesign bypass is unavailable. The README also documents containers, sharing, multitasking, tweaks, and SideStore support. Several implementation paths are unsampled, so those capabilities are shown without speculative internal call chains.
